reason: I already have a domain from the old site, and here my own domain only comes with the 40 € plan. On 25 € the site lives on your address, so if I stop paying I lose it. I raised my prices twice this year and I'm not signing up for another monthly bill that leaves me with nothing when I cancel.
objection: If I cancel, do I keep my domain, my menu and my photos, or does the site just disappear? Your own domain on the 40 € plan only tells me I'd be renting my web address from you.
would_change_my_mind: My existing domain connected on the 25 € plan, plus a written promise that if I cancel I get a full export of the site and menu that I can host elsewhere.
